title: CHATCOM normalized message
description: One chat message after ingest. Every adapter (WhatsApp now; iMessage and Telegram later) writes this shape, one JSON object per line. System lines (joins, subject changes, the encryption notice) are not messages and never appear here.

id.description: Content hash of (sender, UTC minute, ordinal within that sender-minute, normalized text). Stable across re-exports of the same chat, so overlapping exports de-duplicate.

sender.description: Display name after aliases. A sender shown only as a phone number is masked ('Unnamed 1') until the operator sets an alias.

time.description: ISO 8601 with the show's UTC offset at that moment. WhatsApp exports carry local time with no zone; the show's timezone resolves it, including the repeated hour at a DST fall-back.

text.description: Normalized text: NFC, invisible direction marks removed, the 'edited' marker removed. Empty for a media-only or deleted message.

media.description: Kind of attachment when the export replaced it with a placeholder. CHATCOM never reads media files.

reply_to.description: id of the message this one replies to. Always null for WhatsApp .txt exports (the format does not carry it).

line.description: First line of the message in the export file.
